pages.quiz:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #2 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which sound does the Arabic letter م make? (1 mark)
   A. l as in lamp
   B. t as in tap
   C. d as in dog
   D. m as in mat

2. How do you read the syllable دُ? (1 mark)
   A. si
   B. du
   C. ba
   D. li

3. How do you read the syllable بُو? (1 mark)
   A. na
   B. tu
   C. buu
   D. ti

4. What is blending? (1 mark)
   A. Drawing a picture
   B. Joining syllables or sounds together to read a word
   C. Writing a letter
   D. Spelling backwards

5. What does the Arabic sentence أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hello, Ahmad.
   B. My grandfather is old (big in age).
   C. My sister is beautiful.
   D. My brother is small.

6. How do you read the syllable بُ? (1 mark)
   A. du
   B. bu
   C. thaa
   D. laa

7. In what order do you say the letters when you spell an Arabic word aloud? (1 mark)
   A. From left to right
   B. In any order
   C. From the last letter only
   D. From right to left

8. What is a good way to give peer feedback on reading? (1 mark)
   A. Laugh at mistakes
   B. Only point out errors
   C. Say what went well and give one tip to improve
   D. Say nothing

9. Which day is al-khamiis? (1 mark)
   A. Thursday
   B. Friday
   C. Saturday
   D. Tuesday

10. What is a good aim in a reading contest? (1 mark)
   A. To read as loudly as possible
   B. To read as fast as possible
   C. To read correctly and smoothly
   D. To read without looking

11. Which Arabic sentence means "A gift for Amina." (1 mark)
   A. هَذِهِ حَفْلَةٌ
   B. فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ
   C. عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كَعْكَةٌ
   D. هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ

12. Which sentence means 'On the table there is a cake'? (1 mark)
   A. fawqa t-taawilati baaluun
   B. hadiyya li-Aminata
   C. haadhihi hafla
   D. ʿalaa t-taawilati kaʿka

13. What does the Arabic sentence الْعَصِيرُ بَارِدٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The juice is cold.
   B. I like food.
   C. Water is useful (good for you).
   D. The fish is delicious.

14. How is the Arabic word ذُرَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. khudaar
   B. sukkar
   C. bataatis
   D. dhura

15. How is the Arabic word شَعْرٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. shaʿr
   B. ʿayn
   C. udhun
   D. wajh

16. What does jism mean? (1 mark)
   A. head
   B. body
   C. heart
   D. hand

17. When reciting a poem, what should your actions do? (1 mark)
   A. Show something different from the words
   B. Copy a friend's actions
   C. Hide the words
   D. Match the meaning of the words

18. Which Arabic word means "cold"? (1 mark)
   A. سَحَابٌ
   B. حَارٌّ
   C. بَارِدٌ
   D. رِيحٌ

19. How is the Arabic word مِلْعَقَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. qalam
   B. hadiiqa
   C. baab
   D. milʿaqa

20. How does a reading circle work? (1 mark)
   A. Only the teacher reads
   B. Everyone reads silently
   C. Each learner takes a turn to read aloud
   D. One learner reads for the whole hour

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Translate into English: al-ʿasiiru baarid (2 marks)

22. Translate into English: al-miftaahu fii l-khizaana (2 marks)

23. Translate into English: lii ʿaynaani (2 marks)

24. Describe how a class can make a letter bank. (3 marks) (3 marks)

25. Write the seven days in Arabic sounds and say what the first five names come from. (5 marks) (5 marks)

26. Describe how a group can stage a poem at an interclass festival. (4 marks) (4 marks)

27. Explain the three reading strategies: decoding, cues and word spacing. (3 marks) (3 marks)

28. Describe how to make a vocabulary bank of words about the home. (3 marks) (3 marks)

29. Say what a vocabulary bank is and how you can make one from a poem. (3 marks) (3 marks)

30. Explain what it means to read with fluency and give two tips for reading fluently. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #2 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — m as in mat
   The letter م makes the sound m as in mat.

2. B — du
   دُ is read du.

3. C — buu
   بُو is read buu.

4. B — Joining syllables or sounds together to read a word
   Blending means saying the sounds one after another and joining them into a word.

5. C — My sister is beautiful.
   أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ (ukhtii jamiila) means: My sister is beautiful.

6. B — bu
   بُ is read bu.

7. D — From right to left
   We spell Arabic in the direction it is written, from right to left.

8. C — Say what went well and give one tip to improve
   Feedback should be honest and kind.

9. A — Thursday
   al-khamiis is Thursday, the fifth day, from the word for five.

10. C — To read correctly and smoothly
   Accuracy and smoothness matter more than speed.

11. D — هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ
   هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ (hadiyya li-Aminata) means: A gift for Amina.

12. D — ʿalaa t-taawilati kaʿka
   ʿalaa means on, taawila is table and kaʿka is cake.

13. A — The juice is cold.
   الْعَصِيرُ بَارِدٌ (al-ʿasiiru baarid) means: The juice is cold.

14. D — dhura
   ذُرَةٌ is read dhura and means maize.

15. A — shaʿr
   شَعْرٌ is read shaʿr and means hair.

16. B — body
   jism means body.

17. D — Match the meaning of the words
   Actions must match the words to help the audience understand.

18. C — بَارِدٌ
   بَارِدٌ (baarid) means cold.

19. D — milʿaqa
   مِلْعَقَةٌ is read milʿaqa and means spoon.

20. C — Each learner takes a turn to read aloud
   In a reading circle each learner reads in turn.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: The juice is cold.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: The key is in the cupboard.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: I have two eyes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Give each group some letters; write each letter and its name on a card with a picture or word that begins with it; arrange the cards in order in the class portfolio.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for writing cards, 1 mark for adding names or words and 1 mark for arranging them.

25. (5 marks)
   Answer: al-ahad, al-ithnayn, ath-thulaathaa', al-arbiʿaa', al-khamiis, al-jumuʿa, as-sabt. The first five come from the numbers one to five.
   Working / marking points: 3 marks for the days (2 for five or six, 1 for three or four) and 2 marks for the numbers clue.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: Choose a group; share the lines and actions; stand facing the audience; say the poem together with actions; bow at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Decoding: sounding out each letter and mark. Cues: using pictures and the sentence to guess. Word spacing: looking at the spaces to see where words begin and end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each strategy.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: Write each Arabic word on a card with a picture; write the sound and meaning on the back; keep the cards in a box or on a chart and use them to practise.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: A vocabulary bank keeps new words for later. Pick out the words from the poem and write each with its sound, meaning and a picture on cards.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning and 2 marks for the method.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fluency means reading smoothly at a steady speed with correct words. Tips: put a finger under each word; practise at slow and normal speed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning and 1 mark for each tip.
